slides.name: Get the apprentice license
slides.catch: It opens your official TDLR hour record.

slides.name: Log your on-the-job hours
slides.line: Hours are verified, under a master electrician
slides.catch: You need them before you can sit the journeyman exam.

slides.name: Aim for the master license
slides.catch: It also needs two years holding a journeyman license.

slides.title: Not in Texas?
slides.sub: See electrician license rules for your state.
